main.description: Get private-tier posts by AT-URI. Requires auth by a ready community member. A URI that does not exist, is not authorized for the requester, or cannot be served is omitted from the response; other URIs are unaffected. Audiences this AppView resolves: `list` (the audience record's members); `followers` (followers of the audience's owner who are ready members of this AppView, by the follow records it has indexed, which reflect a new follow or an unfollow within about a minute); `everyone` (every ready member of this AppView, not the network); and `nobody`. A `following` audience is not resolved yet and is served to its author only, as is any other mode. A block record or a private block between the reader and the author, or the audience's owner, in either direction, keeps the reader out; a block through a list does not.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.
